events.title: Making Sense of Chaos — Exhibition by Terry Havlis Drahos
events.description: Multimedia art exhibition. 3D assemblages from multiple layers of glass creating depth, reflection, and shifting relationships between images. Gallery hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (by chance or appointment). Opening reception Oct 1 at 7pm.

events.title: Long Call, Roo Wonfor, S. Ayton
events.description: Long Call Sibling duo based in Halifax/Kjipuktuk, Nova Scotia, made up of Avalon (she/they) and Landen (he/him) Moore. Sometimes very quiet, sometimes very loud (both personally and musically). A lil queer and a relatively tall guy. Indie rock/chamber pop/alt folk. Long Call has booked, managed and played four national tours, performing to growing audiences in bars, backyards, living rooms, and theatres across the country and at home in Halifax. Long Call's single "The Last Time We Spoke" releases on October 2, 2026, and their album Everything Will Be Alright is set for release in April 2027.

events.title: Fall Gala: Jonathan Biss, piano
events.description: Biss is recognized globally for his “impeccable taste and formidable technique” ( The New Yorker ) and has appeared as a soloist with some of the world’s foremost orchestras, including the Los Angeles and New York Philharmonics, the Boston Symphony, the Royal Concertgebouw, the London Symphony and more. Biss is also the author of Unquiet: My Life with Beethoven , in which he examines music and his own life's journey through the lens of Beethoven's last piano sonatas. He has served as the Co-Artistic Director of the Marlboro Music School and Festival alongside pianist Mitsuko Uchida since 2018.

events.title: Sonata Night
events.description: Join us for the final showcase of LAMP’s 2026 Academy season, featuring the young artists of the Sonatas with Biss Academy . After a week-long residency at LAMP, these musicians will present the culmination of their work under the guidance of world-renowned pianist Jonathan Biss . Throughout the Academy, artists will work closely with Biss and their fellow musicians, exploring sonata repertoire through private lessons, rehearsals, and performance. events.title: "Fellow Creatures" Exhibition by Michael Peters
events.description: Join us on Thursday, October 29th at 7:00 PM for the Opening Reception and Artist Talk for “Fellow Creatures,” our upcoming Exhibition by Michael Peters. In the exhibition of mixed-media drawing and paintings on paper—Fellow Creatures—Michael reimagines whales, sharks, jellyfish, octopuses and other marine creatures not as simple depictions of nature, but as talismans forged from earth and sea. events.title: Sound & Sketch at Lunenburg School of the Arts
events.description: What does music look like? In Sound & Sketch , you will embark on a creative journey where sound and visual expression come together. Through live viola performances of vivid, colorful pieces - some inspired by folk tales and storytelling - you are encouraged to explore how music creates emotions, scenes, and characters.
